title: sansevieria fragrans

This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including air purification and stress relief, due to its ability to remove toxins and pollutants from the air. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
